title: Awards Gallery Who We Are
description: Image with a gold badge beside an eyebrow, two-part heading, intro text and a grid of feature cards.

text.default: Awards Gallery Philippines was founded in the early 1950s by a family of master engravers who believed that recognition deserved something real — something you could hold, feel the weight of, and keep for a lifetime.

default.title: Expertise
default.text: 70+ years of hands-on engraving mastery — three generations of Filipino artisans.

default.title: Creative & Custom
default.text: We don't do cookie-cutter. Every award is an original built around your vision.

default.title: Top-Grade Materials
default.text: Modern and traditional techniques applied to only the finest materials available.

default.title: Timely Delivery
default.text: Standard 5–10 working day lead time. Rush orders accommodated when available.
